$comment: The contract between the Rust host (NazarCapture.exe) and the C# engine (NazarCapture.Engine.exe).
Both test suites load this file and check their constants, defaults and normalisation against it
(src/contract.rs, tests/NazarCapture.Engine.Tests/Core/ContractTests.cs), so a change on one side
fails a test until the file and the other side agree. Message numbers are offsets from WM_APP.

settings.$comment: UTF-16LE with BOM, read and written through the Win32 profile API; the host owns writes, the engine only reads.

appearance.$settled_once: 1 = light, 2 = dark, as in Hams. Up to 1.1.3 there was also 0 = like Windows: the host replaces any other value in an existing file once at start-up with the palette Windows shows then, and saves it.

settings_version.$settled_once: The layout of the file. Missing (written before 1.1.6) or smaller: the host settles the file once at start-up (a folder that is still Mosaik Capture's default, Pictures\Mosaiks-Screenshots or Videos\Mosaiks-Aufnahmen, becomes the new default) and saves it.

numbers.$comment: How a stored number is read: a decimal 32-bit integer; anything else means the key's default (null). A flag is on for any non-zero number.

$comment: The engine's settings window talks to the host with WM_COPYDATA (SendMessageTimeout); the host stays the only writer
of settings.ini. dwData is the request, the payload UTF-16LE text without terminator: set = key TAB value,
check_hotkey = key TAB combination, suspend_hotkeys = 1 (release both while a hotkey is being recorded) or 0.
The reply is the message result; 0 means not understood or not ready.

exit_codes.$comment: Only what scripts and CI distinguish; every other failure is 1.

$comment: Test only. With instance_variable set, both programs append ".Test.<instance>" to every name above
(mutexes, window class and title), use <temp>\NazarCapture.Test.<instance> instead of %LOCALAPPDATA%,
and the host never touches autostart. Characters other than A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - become _. The host also
isolates itself (as instance "preview") when only config_variable is set, and passes both variables
to the engine it starts. simulate_busy_message (wParam 1 = busy, 0 = idle) exists only in an isolated engine.
